about: A copy of Magnusim CAD's code, made by Magnusim's scripts/export-cad-repo.mjs. Code changes are made in Magnusim, and arrive here with the next copy. "executables": the files Magnusim's git has as executable (100755), which this repository's commit adds with git add --chmod=+x.
lockfile: pruned from Magnusim's (npm install --package-lock-only --offline): 362 packages, all as in Magnusim's
